name: Enaid von Hellerstern
source:
Enaid is a stunningly attractive girl; however, her behavior is difficult to associate with her appearance. She is visibly stressed by some strange perception issues that she struggles to explain, and she always looks tired and disoriented. Talking to her can be challenging because she tends to speak in a very complicated manner.

[spoiler]
Original Enaid von Hellerstern was a pop singer with Lavinia Browning as her producer. Also wife of Cyneburg von Hellerstern, head of engineering at Teutonae's bionic unit.
